# Psalm 54 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David, when the Ziphites went and told Saul, 'Is not David hiding among us?'

**2** O God, save me by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might.

**3** O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

**4** For strangers have risen against me; ruthless men seek my life; they do not set God before themselves. Selah.

**5** Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is the upholder of my life.

**6** He will return the evil to my enemies; in Your faithfulness put an end to them.

**7** With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to You; I will give thanks to Your name, O LORD, for it is good.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **54:1**: The historical context: 1 Samuel 23:19 — the Ziphites betrayed David's location to Saul. The psalm is born from betrayal.

— LOGOS
